title: fix(infinite-hits): do not write cache with incomplete state caused by dynamic widgets
body:
**Summary**

In an InstantSearch implementation with dynamic widgets and a custom infinite hits cache, the latter gets overwritten incorrectly because facets are not initially known (until their relevant widgets are mounted by dynamic widgets).

This PR detects this context and prevents writing an incomplete state in the cache.


FX-1647
